objects.name: Analytic 1768
objects.description: For iOS, detect Archive Collected Data from documented management, network, or vetting evidence; treat state queries as periodic observations rather than real-time events. Correlate Application Permission via Application Vetting [Code-signing entitlements and Info.plist privacy usage-description keys]; Application State via Apple MDM [InstalledApplicationList / ManagedApplicationList]; File Creation via Application Vetting / Forensic Acquisition [Dynamic filesystem trace or acquired app-container/filesystem artifacts: App writes large container, temp package, or high-entropy blob to container-local storage after clustered data access — staged archive artifact]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Correlation window between lifecycle event, local package creation, and upload
Managed apps expected to archive, export, or synchronize data
Approved cloud, enterprise, or sync endpoints for legitimate exports
Whether packaging or export should occur only during active user interaction
Minimum size for suspicious local package or blob
Threshold for identifying encrypted or compressed staged output
Minimum outbound volume consistent with recently created archive
